goals.text: **Convergence Asymptote + Topic Gate** - `python memory/orchestrator/convergence_asymptote.py`: fit an asymptote to the autonomy-score time series (memory/ops/autonomy-score.json); predict plateau value + cycles-to-plateau; write `convergence_state` (CLIMBING | PLATEAU) into fleet-mode.json. Gate round-topic selection: near-PLATEAU -> propose maintenance/hardening topics, CLIMBING -> propose capability topics; feed to topic_scorer. Verified: on 12+ cycles of data the fitted plateau is within +/-0.5 cycle of the observed bend; state flips correctly on a synthetic climb vs a synthetic plateau; fleet-mode.json carries convergence_state. (verified: 2026-11-26 - convergence_asymptote.py built + selftest passed (12-cycle synthetic climb/plateau, state flips correct); real run: 4 pts R^2=0.9964, plateau=78.42, c2p=130.87, state=CLIMBING written to fleet-mode.js)

**fleet-mode.json Drift Reconciler** - `python memory/orchestrator/mode_reconcile.py`: each pass, recompute ground-truth mode from (open-goal count via goal_ledger) + seat reachability, diff against fleet-mode.json; on mismatch self-heal the SSOT and append a drift event to memory/ops/mode-drift.jsonl {ts, field, was, now, cause}. Verified: inject a stale mode, run reconciler -> healed in 1 pass + drift event logged; idempotent (2nd run 0 events); no false positive when mode is already correct. (verified: 2026-11-26 - mode_reconcile.py built + selftest passed (stale mode healed in 1 pass, idempotent 2nd run 0 events, no false positive on correct mode); real run detected 4-field drift from stale cycle-18 values and )

**Dispatch Anti-Stale Conformance Audit** - `python memory/orchestrator/dispatch_audit.py`: replay the last N auto-loop dispatches from autoloop.jsonl; assert 0 dispatches of an already-reached goal AND 0 generic-menu items handed while open goals exist; write conformance score (violations/dispatches) to memory/ops/dispatch-conformance.json. Verified: on a seeded history with 3 injected stale dispatches, audit finds all 3 + conformance<100%; on a clean history conformance=100%; N configurable. (verified: 2026-11-26 - dispatch_audit.py refactored to pure audit_window+count_open; hermetic --selftest PASS (3 injected stale all found, clean=100%, N configurable); real run conformance 93.63% (10/157 stale, all research)

**Idle-to-Work Mode Rebalancer** - `python memory/orchestrator/idle_rebalance.py`: read per-role productive-pass rate (autoloop.jsonl); when a role's idle pass is NOT productive for K consecutive passes, flip its next-pass mode MAINTENANCE->WORK (or route to the open-goal queue) and log the flip. Couples pillar-1 mode to pillar-3 idle productivity. Verified: a synthetic unproductive-idle sequence triggers exactly one flip per threshold crossing; a productive idle does not flip; flips logged with role+ts+reason; idempotent on re-run. (verified: 2026-11-26 - idle_rebalance.py built; --selftest 4/4 PASS (5-idle run K=3 -> exactly 1 flip, productive idle -> 0, MAINTENANCE-flip shape has role/ts/reason, re-run over same records -> 0); real run scanned 1128 autoloop passes, 0 flips emitted (no role stuck in unproductive maintenance at K=3), state file tracks all 15 roles in MAINTENANCE; idempotent 2nd run = 0 new flips)

**Autonomous Round-Chair Protocol** - `python memory/orchestrator/auto_chair.py`: the runbook + script that chairs a cycle transition END-TO-END without a human: detect 100% (or PLATEAU) -> archive old lane files -> draft candidate goals (skeleton generator + topic_scorer) -> write memory/goals/<name>.md -> emit a single ratification request. This goal automates the chairing I perform manually each cycle. Verified: on a synthetic closed cycle it archives, drafts non-anti-repeat goals, writes all lane files, and emits exactly one ratification request; a second run is idempotent (no double-archive / no duplicate goals). (verified: 2026-11-26 - auto_chair.py built; --selftest 4/4 PASS in hermetic temp dir (archives researcher+mechanic, writes all lane files, anti-repeat skips existing 'Source Confidence Decay Tracker', emits exactly 1 ratification request, state stabilizes on re-runs with 0 new archives + no dup goals, trigger=false takes no action); real --dry-run correctly gated on trigger=false (fleet ~63%, convergence CLIMBING not PLATEAU); safe by default: writes only under --execute AND trigger true)

**Cross-Lane Convergence Coupling Map** - `python memory/orchestrator/convergence_coupling.py`: for each lane compute (a) its contribution to fleet autonomy and (b) the single upstream dependency that most limits its convergence; rank lanes by "one-intervention-lifts-most." Output memory/ops/convergence-coupling.json. Verified: on current data flags the true laggards (outlet, forge) as the highest-leverage targets; each lane has exactly one named limiting dependency; re-running after a fix lowers that lane's limit score. (verified: 2026-11-26 - convergence_coupling.py built; --selftest 4/4 PASS (outlet+forge top-3 on synthetic, one limiter/lane, fix lowers limit_score); real run wrote memory/ops/convergence-coupling.json - outlet #1 lev=121.)

**Convergence Regression Sentinel** - `python memory/orchestrator/convergence_sentinel.py`: watch autonomy-score.json across cycles; on DROP > threshold from last cycle (regression, not mere deceleration) AUTO-OPEN a remediation goal in the responsible lane + alert to memory/ops/alerts.jsonl. Verified: a synthetic 8pt drop auto-opens exactly one correctly-attributed remediation goal + alert; a steady/accelerating series opens none; attribution matches the lane whose change preceded the drop. (verified: 2026-11-26 - convergence_sentinel.py built; --selftest 4/4 PASS (8pt drop->1 alert+goal+idempotent, accelerating->none, duration_score->mechanic attribution, below-threshold->none); real run status=ok cycle 24 score 71.3 climbing)

**Human-Ratification Minimizer** - `python memory/orchestrator/ratification_audit.py`: log EVERY human touch in the cycle lifecycle (goal-set trigger, ratification, unblock, redirect) to memory/ops/human-touches.jsonl; compute touches/cycle trend + a per-touch removal plan (which automation eliminates it). Target <1 touch/cycle. Verified: 2 seeded cycles produce correct touch counts + a removal plan that names an existing/new automation per touch; re-running is append-only. (verified: 2026-11-26 - ratification_audit.py built; --selftest 4/4 PASS (seeded cycles correct counts, append-only idempotent, clean cycle=0, all 4 types classified); real run: 7 cycles 30 touches avg 4.29/cycle baseline established; removal plan names existing automations per type)

**Convergence-Aware Seat Sizing** - `python memory/orchestrator/seat_sizing.py`: from per-seat productive-pass rate + goal-completion + role-redundancy (overlap with other seats' completed scope), recommend SCALE / RE-ROLE / RETIRE per seat for the next cycle; write recommendations to memory/ops/seat-sizing.json. Feeds my HR onboarding/re-role duty. Verified: on current data recommends a defensible action per seat with evidence citations; a seat whose scope is 100% subsumed by another is flagged RETIRE-candidate; recompute after a retire reflects the change. (verified: 2026-11-26 - seat_sizing.py built; --selftest 4/4 PASS; real run: 8 SCALE + 6 MAINTAIN, 0 RETIRE/RE-ROLE)

**Dispatch-Forecast Calibration Loop** - `python memory/orchestrator/forecast_calibration.py`: track next10.json forecast accuracy per lane (predicted vs actual reached); compute Brier score + calibration curve; flag miscalibrated lanes and feed the residual back into topic/goal selection (weight under-forecast lanes' goals higher). Verified: on historical cycles Brier scores computed + a known-bad forecaster is flagged; feeding the residual measurably raises next-cycle dispatch precision vs a no-feedback baseline. (verified: 2026-11-26 - forecast_calibration.py built; --selftest 4/4 PASS; real run Brier=0.203 better than random; mechanic worst over-forecaster gap+0.76)
